type Shape = { kind: "square"; size: number } | { kind: "circle"; radius: number };

function assertNever(value: never): never {
  throw new Error(`unexpected: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
}

function area(shape: Shape): number {
  if (shape.kind === "square") return shape.size * shape.size;
  else if (shape.kind === "circle") return 3 * shape.radius * shape.radius;
  const unreachable: never = shape;
  return unreachable;
}

function shapeName(shape: Shape | undefined): string {
  if (!shape) return "none";
  if (shape.kind === "square") return "square";
  if (shape.kind === "circle") return "circle";
  return assertNever(shape);
}

function notCircle(shape: Shape): string {
  if (shape.kind === "square") return "square";
  if (shape.kind !== "circle") {
    const unreachable: never = shape;
    return unreachable;
  }
  return `circle of ${shape.radius}`;
}

type Result = { ok: true; value: number } | { ok: false; error: string };

function unwrap(result: Result): string {
  if (result.ok) return `value ${result.value}`;
  if (!result.ok) return `error ${result.error}`;
  const unreachable: never = result;
  return unreachable;
}

interface Drawing {
  shape: Shape;
}

function drawingName(drawing: Drawing): string {
  if (drawing.shape.kind === "square") return "square drawing";
  if (drawing.shape.kind === "circle") return "circle drawing";
  return assertNever(drawing.shape);
}

class Holder {
  constructor(public shape: Shape) {}
  describe(): string {
    if (this.shape.kind === "square") return "holds a square";
    if (this.shape.kind === "circle") return "holds a circle";
    const unreachable: never = this.shape;
    return unreachable;
  }
}

function destructured(shape: Shape): string {
  const { kind } = shape;
  if (kind === "square") return `side ${shape.size}`;
  if (kind === "circle") return `radius ${shape.radius}`;
  return assertNever(shape);
}

console.log(area({ kind: "square", size: 2 }), area({ kind: "circle", radius: 1 }));
console.log(shapeName(undefined), shapeName({ kind: "circle", radius: 2 }));
console.log(notCircle({ kind: "circle", radius: 4 }));
console.log(unwrap({ ok: true, value: 1 }), unwrap({ ok: false, error: "bad" }));
console.log(drawingName({ shape: { kind: "circle", radius: 1 } }));
console.log(new Holder({ kind: "square", size: 1 }).describe());
console.log(destructured({ kind: "circle", radius: 5 }));
